about: Skill packs (2026-11-06). 'base' is always on. Every other pack is off for a new stack and is switched on by the person (/paquete NAME si) or by the operator. A skill that is in no pack (one the agent or the person made) is never touched. A skill in several packs stays on while any of them is on. hermes-agent can never be switched off (Hermes refuses).

base.title: Base
base.about: browsing the internet, YouTube, speech to text, simple lookups and what the bot needs to work

edicion.title: Media editing
edicion.about: edit and convert video, audio and images (ffmpeg, GPU, DaVinci Resolve, EffectCraft), understand a video, identify songs

mundo.title: World
mundo.about: places and maps, weather and live data, recognise the song that is playing; later, an interpreter between languages (maps and weather are always included)

revista.title: Magazine
revista.about: follow Telegram channels, blogs and news, and get a magazine every morning with the important things first (YouTube later)

creativo.title: Images and design
creativo.about: generate images and short videos, infographics, diagrams, animations, music and GIFs

empleo.title: Job search
empleo.about: search and evaluate job ads, adapt the CV (read and create PDF), follow applications

presupuesto.title: Budget and prices
presupuesto.about: taxes, utilities, everyday expenses in Argentina and price tracking

oficina.title: Documents and office
oficina.about: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, meetings, email, Google Workspace, Box, Obsidian

investigacion.title: Research
investigacion.about: papers, sourced citations, a personal wiki, tracking competitors and X

programacion.title: Programming
programacion.about: coding agents, review, debugging, tests, GitHub

codigos.title: QR and barcodes
codigos.about: read and create QR codes and barcodes from photos or videos

seguridad.title: Downloaded file check
seguridad.about: check whether a downloaded .exe, .dll, installer, script or .zip is listed as a known threat (only the hash travels; you need your own free abuse.ch key for the second list)

electricidad.title: Electricidad: obras e instalaciones
electricidad.about: normativa argentina (AEA 90364, normas IRAM, SRT, distribuidoras), materiales y fabricantes nacionales, cuánto aguanta cada cable, térmica y disyuntor, cálculo de cables, caída de tensión y protecciones, tableros, edificios, seguridad en obra, mediciones y puesta en servicio, diagnóstico de fallas y revisión de un tablero por foto

vehiculos.title: Vehículos: autos, trámites y reparaciones
vehiculos.about: ley de tránsito y señales, multas y cómo pagar menos, peajes y TelePASE, seguro obligatorio y siniestros, papeles del auto (registro, cédula, patente, VTV, licencia), preparar un viaje y cruzar a países vecinos, mantenimiento y diagnóstico, y reparaciones del VW Gol cuadrado 1994

sitio.title: Own website
sitio.about: edit and publish the person's website (only where it is configured)

sysadmin.title: Sysadmin: your own servers
sysadmin.about: check the security of your servers and sites with citable rules (and, later, fix with your confirmation), network diagnosis, a read-only view of Proxmox where the operator configured it and of your Zabbix monitoring (with your own read-only token)

equipo.title: Bot team: tasks between them
equipo.about: leave a task for another of your bots (or for you) on a Gitea board and see the ones left for you (only where the operator configured the board)

ocio.title: Idle-time work
ocio.about: queue sketches, tests and variants to be made in idle time, one small unit at a time, never interrupting anyone; the person is told once what was done (only where the operator turned it on for the stack)

difusion.title: Broadcast: your channel
difusion.about: prepare the posts of your Telegram channel: the bot drafts, you approve from your chat and only then it is published (only where the operator configured the channel)

maquinas.title: Remote machines
maquinas.about: power on, look at and enter a remote machine with credit (only where the operator gave you an account)

lugar.title: Game PC
lugar.about: run a game on your own streaming PC by name, see when it is ready to enter, freeze or switch it off (only where the operator gave you one)
